indication_area: Dermatology (inflammatory lesions of non-nodular moderate to severe acne vulgaris)
moa: Tetracycline-class antibiotic (minocycline) with anti-inflammatory activity, topical foam

approval_evidence.quote: This new drug application provides for the use of AMZEEQ (minocycline) topical foam, 4% to treat inflammatory lesions of non-nodular moderate to severe acne vulgaris in patients 9 years of age and older.

launch_evidence.quote: The Company launched AMZEEQ in the United States in January 2020 and commenced generating product revenues in the first quarter of 2020.

series_start_reason: Series starts at the first quarter Journey Medical owned the product: Journey acquired Amzeeq and Zilxi from VYNE Therapeutics in January 2022 (Journey Form 10-Q, Q3 2025, product-acquisition note: 'In January 2022, the Company entered into an asset purchase agreement with VYNE Therapeutics, Inc. to acquire two FDA approved products'). The product launched earlier under Foamix/VYNE (launch_quarter, per VYNE's 10-Q); VYNE's per-product history is not available (see search_log), so the series begins at 2022Q1. The prior-year column of the Q1 2022 10-Q is nil.
series_end_reason: From the Q3 2025 Form 10-Q (filed 2025-11-12, accession 0001104659-25-110457) Journey prints the two products as one line, 'Foam franchise products (Amzeeq & Zilxi)' (1,311 thousand for Q3 2025 vs 2,100), replacing the separate lines it printed through the Q2 2025 10-Q. The combined line is a different scope and is not split or spliced.
notes: Scope: Journey Medical's Amzeeq line in its revenues-by-product table, in USD thousands (converted to millions), net product revenues; Journey states 'All of the Company's product revenues are recorded in the U.S.' (Form 10-K FY2022, revenues note). Amounts exclude Journey's separately reported Other revenue (e.g. supply of Amzeeq to Cutia Therapeutics from August 2025, after the series end). Fourth quarters are derived as the 10-K full year less the Q3 10-Q nine-month column. Sibling product Zilxi comes from the same tables. Prior owner: Foamix, then VYNE Therapeutics (Menlo), which did not print a per-product line (search_log).
search_log: Listed Journey Medical (CIK 1867066) filings via data.sec.gov submissions and downloaded every 10-Q, 10-K and Item 2.02 8-K exhibit (form filter: any form starting 8-K with item 2.02, plus 10-Q and 10-K, 2021-11 to 2026-08). The earnings-release exhibits 99.1 carry no product table (searched for Amzeeq/Zilxi rows: none; only prose); the 10-Q revenues-by-product tables carry the three-month figures, and the 10-K carries full years.
Journey did not own either product before January 2022, so its first filing with a product line is the Q1 2022 10-Q (filed 2022-05-10). Its Q3 2021 10-Q (filed 2021-12-16) predates the acquisition.

Fourth quarters are derived (full year in the 10-K less the nine-month column of the Q3 10-Q) because no Journey document prints a stand-alone fourth quarter by product (checked the 8-K exhibit 99.1 of each year-end release, 2023-03 to 2026-03).

From the Q3 2025 10-Q (filed 2025-11-12) the revenues-by-product table prints one line 'Foam franchise products (Amzeeq & Zilxi)' (1,311 for the quarter, 2,100 a year earlier), and the 10-K FY2025 and 10-Qs of 2026 use the same combined XBRL member (FoamFranchiseProductsAmzeeqZilxiMember); no separate Amzeeq or Zilxi line was found there.

Prior owner: downloaded VYNE Therapeutics (formerly Menlo/Foamix, CIK 1566044) 10-Q, 10-K and Item 2.02 8-K exhibits 2019-10 to 2022-05 and searched for Amzeeq/Zilxi rows. VYNE prints product revenue in prose ('product revenue of $1.8 million for the three months ended March 31, 2020') and a combined AMZEEQ and ZILXI product revenue from the fourth quarter of 2020, with no per-product line; the prior-owner history is therefore not a continuous per-product series and is not spliced.

Annual cross-check: the four quarters of each year sum to the 10-K full year by construction for 2022-2024 (fourth quarter derived); the first three quarters of each year equal the nine-month column of the Q3 10-Q.
